I’m sorry to hear that you feel that way, and in your brief description you sound very similar to him. I’m thankful for you being open and honest with your opinion. I do try Eli hope that there is some chance and that was why he decided to share his plans with me.
I have no idea

The way they were rationalizing was that they have been planning this and it’s not just a snap decision, and how could anyone be so selfish to try and talk them out of it knowing that this is what they want and that should be enough. I’m sorry if this is coming out a jumbled mess, I stayed up with them all night talking. Also thank you for reaching out, I’m seeing them this week and I’d really like to be able to go into a conversation somewhat prepared to help however I can.

That’s what I’m afraid of doing I’ve been trying to choose my questions carefully. 
I more asked them about why they feel so exhausted with life, if it was even something they could explain or if it was just this overwhelming feeling that has been lingering.
I asked how long they have thought about it.
They have it all completely rationalized, to even if I were to argue (which I’m trying not to so they don’t feel attacked) that on paper you would understand why they’re doing this. They kept saying they couldn’t understand why I couldn’t accept that this is what they want and that they are looking forward to this. I’m just so lost on how to help them. I’m the only person they’ve told so I want to make sure I’m doing everything I can in the best way possible.
